## Description

Please provide a summary of the change, the motivation behind it, and any relevant context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring
- [ ] CI / Build configuration update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (no wildcard imports, 120 char line length where possible).
- [ ] I have run `mvn clean test` and all unit and integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (if applicable).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable).
- [ ] My changes generate no new Netty buffer leaks (`-Dio.netty.leakDetection.level=PARANOID`).
